description:
Order a VPS. `product` = plan slug from list_plans; `os_id` = an OS id from that plan's images. Optional `hostname` and `ssh_key` (public key — strongly recommended so you get key-based root login). Optional `location`: "de" (Germany) or "fi" (Finland) — omit it and we pick the location automatically. Orders are never refused for capacity: if the chosen country has no free room or IPv4 right now, the paid server waits in the creation queue in that same country (`get_vps_status` shows `queued: true`) and is created automatically, usually within 24 hours; the customer gets the usual access email. Optional `months` (1–36): the billing term paid upfront — the invoice is the monthly price × months, payment moves the paid-until date by exactly that many months, after that the server renews monthly from the balance; `months: 12` is the annual plan with its discount; terms other than 1 and 12 have no discount. Or `period` ("month" by default, or "year" for annual billing) or an explicit `plan_id` from list_plans `plans[]` (`months` takes precedence over both); an active automatic offer (`plans[].promo`) is applied to the first invoice and the response then carries `promo`. Windows plans (windows-*) accept only the Windows Server 2022 image, ignore `ssh_key`, and are reached over RDP as Administrator (see get_vps_status → access); the licence is BYOL.

Branching on the response:
• `paid_from_balance: true` → the prepaid balance covered it; the server is provisioning. Poll `get_vps_status` until status is `active` and the VM is reachable.
• `paid_from_balance: false` → balance was insufficient; an unpaid `invoice` is returned. Call `pay_invoice` with `invoice.id`: it pays from the balance if the balance now covers it, otherwise it returns a crypto `checkout_url`. Or `topup_balance` and then `pay_invoice` (or re-order).

Several servers in one order: `quantity` 2–50 → one invoice, N separate services (each with its own renewal), names <hostname>-1…<hostname>-N, created one after another after payment (`service_ids` in the response). 50 is only a typo guard — there is no limit for new accounts and no maximum by free capacity: servers that do not fit right now are queued for creation (usually within 24 hours). Promo codes apply to single-server orders paid for 1 or 12 months only. Optional `addons`: "backups" (Managed Backups, monthly plans only — annual plans include them) and "extra_ipv4" (a second public IPv4, dedicated-IP plans only); each add-on is added to the same invoice for every month of the chosen term (the first month on an annual plan), see `get_order_limits` for availability and price. Send the same `idempotency_key` when you retry the same order — a repeated call returns the existing order instead of creating a second one. PROMO until 2026-10-31 23:59 Europe/Kyiv: -25% on ANNUAL billing, first year only, applied automatically (no code) to windows-medium ($171/yr), windows-small-ip ($252/yr) and windows-medium-ip ($324/yr); renewal at the regular annual price; windows-small not included — order with period="year". Requires: token + enough balance (else an unpaid invoice is returned). Never refused for capacity: no free room/IPv4 → the paid server is queued (get_vps_status queued: true, usually ready within 24 hours). Typical errors: 422 unknown product/os_id (see list_plans), 422 quantity above 50, 422 months outside 1–36, 422 coupon_term_only (promo code with a term other than 1 or 12 months).

addons.description: Optional. Add-ons created automatically with each server: "backups", "extra_ipv4".

hostname.description: Optional. Server hostname, a valid DNS name up to 128 characters (letters, digits, dots, hyphens), e.g. "web-1". Default: generated.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retry key of 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", e.g. "web1-2026-10-20". Send the same key when retrying the same order — the existing order is returned instead of creating a second one. Default: none.

location.description: Optional. Server country: "de" (Germany) or "fi" (Finland). Omit for automatic placement.

months.description: Optional. Billing term in months, 1–36 (default 1). Invoice = monthly price × months; 12 = the annual plan with its discount; other terms have no discount. Takes precedence over period/plan_id.

os_id.description: Required. OS image id from the chosen plan's `available_os` in list_plans, integer, e.g. 4 (Ubuntu 24.04).

period.description: Optional. Billing period: "month" (default) or "year" (annual plan). Ignored when `months` or `plan_id` is given.

plan_id.description: Optional. Explicit billing plan id from list_plans `plans[].plan_id`, integer, e.g. 12. Ignored when `months` is given.

product.description: Required. Plan slug from list_plans, e.g. "nano-ip", "small" or "windows-medium-ip".

quantity.description: Optional. How many identical servers to order in one invoice (1–50, default 1). Servers without free room right now are queued for creation, not refused.

ssh_key.description: Optional. OpenSSH public key for root login, one line, e.g. "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3Nza… you@laptop". Strongly recommended for Linux; ignored on Windows plans. Default: none (a root password is generated).
